title: Moofall Protection
description: Moofall Protection makes leather armor soften your landing—each leather piece reduces fall damage by 12.5%, and wearing a full set cuts all fall damage in half.
body: Moofall Protection is a lightweight Minecraft mod that makes leather armor uniquely valuable by reducing fall damage for every leather piece you wear. Each slot grants a 12.5% reduction, allowing a full leather set to cut all fall damage in half. This gives early-game players a new strategic reason to choose leather over heavier armors. The mod works entirely server-side, players don’t need any special client setup to benefit from softer landings.
